question: Which of the following keys will you press in Windows 10 to turn the volume up?
solution:
The correct answer is __**F8.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We **have to simultaneously press** the** Fn + F8** keys to **increase the laptop volume on the keyboard.**
 
• To turn down the volume, press the** Fn + F7** keys at the same time.
 
• The mute volume keyboard shortcut is **Fn + F6.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** F4** opens the address bar in the File Explorer and most browsers, including Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge.
 
• **F5's** most common function is to refresh the current web page.
